recorded: The executable review-control substrate - review-roles/, bin/fm-review-role.sh, the read-only launch bindings in bin/fm-launch-lib.sh, the prospective assignment check in bin/fm-independence-lib.sh, and the --review-role gate in bin/fm-spawn.sh - landed under a one-time captain bootstrap exception, as EXCEPTIONAL and INITIALLY UNCERTIFIED work, and must be independently re-reviewed under the very control it creates before it may be treated as certified.
authority: Captain ruling of 2026-08-11, section 0 of the recurrence-closure commission: proceed under one narrow, explicit bootstrap exception to implement the minimum executable review-control substrate. Its stated conditions include that the maker is not the independent checker, that the landing is recorded as exceptional and initially uncertified, that the new control is immediately used to re-review the bootstrap itself, and that the exception expires automatically once enforcement is operational and is not precedent.
exception_expires_when: Enforcement is operational, as established by the probe below. Exception expiry grants no certification and no standing authority.
satisfied_when: This substrate has been independently reviewed under the operational control by a reviewer that did not make it, with the findings repaired rather than recorded.
control: tests/fm-review-role.test.sh - every safety predicate is watched to fail: the read-only requirement deleted and separately inverted, each of the eighteen required predicates deleted in turn, the author assigned as reviewer, the author identity removed, a reviewer below the role capability floor, a required independence dimension removed and inverted, a harness with no measured read-only binding, and a self-contradicting policy config. Each case asserts the unmutated fixture is ELIGIBLE first, so a control that had broken shut would fail rather than look strict.
unobserved_conditions: No independent review of this substrate by a reviewer that did not make it has been performed or recorded, so the bootstrap remains uncertified however green its own tests are.
The maker of this substrate wrote its tests, so the tests establish that the controls fire and cannot establish that the controls are the right ones.
Whether the two frozen runtime candidates were lawfully reviewed is a separate later obligation and nothing here observes it.
note: This entry is the repository record that the landing was exceptional. The probe answers whether enforcement is operational and therefore whether the exception has expired, but a control certifying itself is the failure this whole substrate exists to refuse. Independent re-review satisfies this uncertified commitment later. Until then, no reader may describe this substrate as certified, and the expired exception grants no standing authority to anything else - it is not precedent.
